summary.name: RerouteMe
summary.one_liner: RerouteMe is a free macOS app that switches the Wi-Fi proxy configuration with one click between localhost, WAN, or custom proxy setups.
use_cases: switch quickly between proxy configurations on macOS
route traffic through a MITM proxy while debugging
enable or disable a Wi-Fi proxy without navigating system settings
toggle between localhost and remote proxy setups during development
summary.what_it_does: The page describes RerouteMe as a macOS app that makes changing the proxy configuration on an existing Wi-Fi connection a single click instead of many steps in system settings. You set up a Localhost, WAN, or Custom proxy configuration once and then switch between them. The page says developers using MITM proxy tools in their daily work can use it to switch proxy configurations while debugging. Beyond these points, the page gives no detail on implementation or the interface.
notable: One-click switching between Localhost, WAN, and Custom proxy configurations
Aimed at developers using MITM proxy tools
caveats: Page does not state requirements, version, or size
